name: School
about: The 200 most used Dutch words for school and studying, each in an everyday sentence written for it. They're the same sentences as in the Dutch word packs (words 1–20,000), so what you learn here counts there too, and the other way round. Word list: FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, from OpenSubtitles (opensubtitles.org), CC BY-SA 4.0.
